name: shared
purpose: One owner per shared-memory quantity on both devices (mechanism-leaf-alignment-plan.md P2): dependent LDS latency in the LDS service leaf (same dependent-chain definition as every other class), per-SMSP issue cost in storage.shared.issue, per-SM acceptance per 128 B wavefront in storage.shared.acceptance_sm, STS -> barrier visibility in storage.shared.visibility. Today Hopper carries 30-91 cycle LDS tables and multi-axis shared tables, Blackwell LDS = 1 plus ~2-cycle issue leaves: shared loads complete in ~3 cycles on B300 and the two devices disagree by 10x.
probe: blackwell-prototype tools/microbench/probes/smem.cu + mb.cuh verbatim into tools/microbench/shared/probe/: lds_chain W (one warp, U dependent ld.shared of W bytes, W in {4, 8, 16}); issue OP D (W warps on SMSP 0 only or on all 4 SMSPs, K independent LDS / STS with D lanes on bank 0 at D rows = D wavefronts, D = 0 broadcast); vis S NW (last-arriver STS x S then bar.sync, t_w on warp 1). SASS gate sass_check.py check_smem verbatim. --launches 8 --reps 33, two runs per device.

derivation.LDS result_latency (instruction.service): slope over U of the lds_chain medians at W = 4 (dependent LDS issue -> dependent issue); W = 8 / 16 reported; completion = result
derivation.storage.shared.issue.cycles (constant pe: issue OP D=1 cell with warps on SMSP 0 only: slope over K / wps = cycles per op per SMSP (LDS, STS; LDSM/STSM take the LDS/STS value until measured, experimental)
derivation.storage.shared.acceptance_sm.cycles line: issue OP D cells with warps on all 4 SMSPs: slope over K / (wps x 4) = cycles per op per SM at D wavefronts; knots at D in {1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32} (D = 0 broadcast maps to 1); the per-SMSP issue cost is NOT subtracted (acceptance is the SM-level limit the engine serializes on; the engine takes max(issue chain, acceptance chain) via two separate rows)
derivation.storage.shared.visibility.cycles (consta: E[t_w - t_s | vis S=1] - o_s(t_s -> STS) - o_w, minus the no-store barrier release (vis S=0 cell) when present; otherwise listed as the raw difference
derivation.runs: two runs per device; a cell is measured when fit residual <= 5 % and the runs agree within 5 %

acceptance.cell: fit max relative residual <= 5 % and run agreement <= 5 % -> measured, else experimental and listed
acceptance.b300_control: LDS issue 1.88 / STS issue 4.39 / acceptance degree table / visibility 13 must be reproduced within 10 %; a failing field is reported with both numbers and installed as experimental on b300
acceptance.h100: install every passing cell; the predecessor LDS table base cell (30) is replaced by the chain slope

install: hopper + blackwell leaves: instruction.service LDS result/completion; storage.shared.issue constants (field_models changes to constant); storage.shared.acceptance_sm linear(shared_wavefronts) knots; storage.shared.visibility constant. Source keys shared.<device>.r1.
not_allowed: no case-cycle tuning; no values from other machines; no threshold change after data
